name: Hitozuma Oshinobi Ryokou ~Okusama-tachi no Nureta Yoru~
original_name: 人妻お忍び旅行 ～奥様達の濡れた夜～
source:
A couple shows up at the doors of a provincial hot springs ryokan. Are their relations pure or lustful?
